items.title: Signup trial nurture sequence
items.summary: Public-safe signup trial nurture subjects, preview text, body copy, and CTA labels.
items.body:
Welcome to PHIGuard: Your account is ready. Continue setup to choose a plan, review the BAA, and start organizing clinic compliance work in one auditable workspace.
Your PHIGuard trial is live: Your 30-day free trial is active with no credit card required. Add billing details before the trial ends if you want service to continue without a pause.
Keep your HIPAA work moving: Use the trial to centralize recurring compliance tasks, incidents, evidence, and audit trail activity before the trial window closes.
